headline: A new law sets a fixed 10-year term for the head of the Government Publishing Office.
what_it_does: The law changes federal code section 44 U.S.C. 301 so that the Director of the Government Publishing Office serves a 10-year term. Before this change, the statute did not set a fixed term for this position. The summary does not describe any other duties, funding, or rules.

who_it_affects.group: The Director of the Government Publishing Office
who_it_affects.how: The person in this job now has a set 10-year term of office.

who_it_affects.group: The Government Publishing Office and its staff
who_it_affects.how: The agency's leadership will be set on a 10-year term instead of an open-ended one.
